title: Two ways in: starting at the app or at the IdP
desc: A comparison of SP-initiated and IdP-initiated sign-in in four rows. Where Priya starts: at the app, or at the IdP, for example an app tile in the Okta dashboard. The sign-in request: the app creates one when sign-in starts at the app, and there is none when it starts at the IdP. Matching the Response to a request: the app can match it when it sent a request, and has nothing to match it to when it did not. The app's checks: all the checks above when sign-in starts at the app, and one fewer, a weaker position, when it starts at the IdP.
